recentItems.title: అంగారకుడి చందమామల గుట్టు విప్పనున్న జపాన్ MMX మిషన్
recentItems.description:
Mars, the red planet, has fascinated humanity for centuries, yet the origin of its two moons — Phobos and Deimos — remains one of space science's greatest unsolved mysteries. To unravel these secrets, Japan's space agency JAXA has set an ambitious goal with its Mars Moon eXploration (MMX) mission. The mission plans to land a rover on one of Mars' moons, collect soil samples, and bring them back to Earth for analysis. This would mark the first time in history that samples have been retrieved from the moons of Mars, making it a truly groundbreaking endeavor. The MMX mission represents a bold step forward in humanity's quest to understand the origins of the Martian moons and the broader solar system.
